item.title: War widens as Israeli and US planes pound Iran and Tehran and its proxies hit back
item.description: Iran and allied armed groups are firing missiles at Israel, Arab states and U.S. military targets around the region. Meanwhile, Israel and the United States are pounding Iran.

item.title: Hegseth insists the Iran conflict is ‘not endless’ and declares, ‘We fight to win’
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is speaking to widening concerns the U.S.-Israeli strikes in Iran could spiral into a protracted regional conflict by declaring, “This is not Iraq. This is not endless.”

item.title: Old Apollo rocks shed new light on the moon’s magnetic field long ago
item.description: Lunar rocks collected by Apollo astronauts more than half a century ago are providing a fresh take on the moon’s mysterious magnetic field, scientists reported Wednesday.

item.title: A week of joy and music: Tabernacle Choir’s Brazil tour ends in São Paulo
item.description: The world tour to São Paulo wrapped up on Sunday night for the Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square, which has spent the past week performing in Brazil.

item.title: Iran’s World Cup place in U.S. put in doubt by Middle East conflict. FIFA has Iraq next in line
item.description: Iran’s place at the men’s soccer World Cup in three months’ time has been put in doubt amid an escalating Middle East conflict sparked by FIFA tournament co-host the United States.

item.title: Anime shop owners report losing thousands in overnight break‑in
item.description: The owners of Super Anime Store reported a break‑in and theft of more than 100 items worth about $4,000 including Pokémon cards.

item.title: US half marathon women’s leaders guided off course in error. One asks officials to ‘make it right’
item.description: The runner who was leading the women's race at the U.S. half marathon championships until she was mistakenly led off the course by a guide vehicle is calling for USA Track & Field to make right an outcome that cost her a spot in the world road running championships this fall.

item.title: Is Salt Lake City emerging as a leader contender for MLB expansion?
item.description: Baseball analysts see Salt Lake City well-positioned to land an MLB team, and there's already a shovel-ready site for a stadium in the Power District.

item.title: As tensions rise overseas, Utah veteran says uncertainty weighs heavily on military families
item.description: As tensions escalate overseas, a Utah Air Force veteran said the impact of global conflict is felt long before any official deployment orders — especially by the families waiting at home.

item.title: Democrats’ newfound unity faces a test after US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: Democrats stay mostly united against President Donald Trump, but the strikes on Iran are starting to reveal some splits in the party.
